construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch within this isolated build directory.

constraints: Unknown fields rejected at every input-object level; all textual fields must be nonblank.
Feedback IDs must be unique after trimming; at most 10000 feedback records.
Feedback text is limited to 5000 characters; other record fields to 200.
Optional custom themes replace defaults; 1..50 themes, each with 1..50 nonempty keyword phrases.
Theme IDs are unique; 'other' is reserved for the fallback theme.
Theme ID/name and keywords are limited to 200 characters; actions to 1000.
CLI accepts UTF-8 JSON with optional BOM, at most 2000000 bytes; duplicate fields and nonstandard constants rejected.

shared_schema.validation_layer: validate_input is shared by analyze and the CLI. File parsing additionally enforces strict JSON and byte limits.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single requested stage: validated normalized feedback and theme definitions enter customer insights; one integrated result is emitted. There are no external or inter-service handoffs.

behavior.theme_matching: Case-folded whole-token phrases; multi-label; unmatched feedback assigned to 'other'. Six default themes cover quality, usability, support, pricing, delivery and feature requests. Custom dictionaries support other domains.
behavior.sentiment: English positive/negative word counts with immediate-token negation; ties are neutral. Record-level sentiment is reused for every assigned theme.
behavior.priority: 3 * negative + neutral + positive counts; descending score, descending count, then ascending theme ID.
behavior.evidence: Up to three complete original-text excerpts per theme sorted by feedback ID, with source and feedback ID. Normalization trims outer whitespace.
behavior.empty_input: Valid empty feedback returns zero counts and empty themes/assignments.
behavior.repeat_feedback: Unique record IDs required, but repeated text and customer IDs retained. Counts are feedback records, not distinct people.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, timestamps, model calls, or mutation of caller input. Input record ordering does not affect results.
behavior.fixture_label: Example and test fixtures are explicitly synthetic.

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object, status ok, six synthetic feedback records and seven themes
